Package com.eloview.sdk.peripheralManager

Class Peripheral

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.consts.Consts
com.eloview.sdk.accountManager.AccountManager
com.eloview.sdk.peripheralManager.Peripheral
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Peripheral extends AccountManager
PeripheralManager class provides below operations.
  • Get an auth token using getEloAccessToken.
  • Enable/Disable device ports using JSON string. Currently only USB ports can be turned ON/OFF using setUSBPorts(String)
  • Get device port status in JSON String format. Currently only USB ports status can be read. using getUSBPorts()
  • Get maximum number of USB ports on the device based on the device model using getMaxUSBPort()
  • Start USB monitoring which will reset USB Debug mode to host mode from device mode and enable the USB ports.startUsbMonitoring()
  • Stop USB monitoring. stopUsbMonitoring()
  • Get attached USB device information. getAttachedPeripheralDetails()
  • Read system property. readSystemProperty(String)

    • getAllUsbAudioDevices

      public List<String> getAllUsbAudioDevices()
      This method is used to get all usb audio devices. It returns a list of Stringified JSON Objects, which have 2 keys: "DeviceName" - String, and "CardNumber" - Integer. The "CardNumber" is what identifies the device, and can be used with setUsbAudioDevice API
      Returns:
      List of Stringified JSON Objects representing all available USB Audio Devices

    • getUsbAudioDevice

      public int getUsbAudioDevice()
      This method is used to get the current usb audio device in use.
      Returns:
      Integer representing the current usb audio device identifier. This is the "CardNumber" referenced in getAllUsbAudioDevices If no device is in use, -1 is returned

    • setUsbAudioDevice

      public boolean setUsbAudioDevice(int device)
      This method is used to set the usb audio device in use. This does not persist across device power cycle.
      Parameters:
      device - Integer representing the usb audio device identifier. This is the "CardNumber" referenced in getAllUsbAudioDevices
      Returns:
      true if the device was set successfully, false otherwise

    • updateUsbWhiteList

      public boolean updateUsbWhiteList(String[] address, boolean whitelist)
      Updates the USB device whitelist and immediately enforces the new policy on all currently connected devices.
      Parameters:
      address - An array of device identifiers, each formatted as "VID:PID" in hexadecimal (e.g., "04F2:B449").
      whitelist - If true, attempts to add the devices to the whitelist. If false, attempts to remove the devices from whitelist.
      Returns:
      True if the list was successfully updated and saved; false otherwise.
